name: Email communication
description: Reply to a professor about a paper deadline with an attachment. The send step cannot be undone.
goal: Reply to Professor Smith's email about the paper deadline: tell her we'll submit the revised draft by Friday, and attach the latest version.
brief: You mean {deadline_day}. The latest version of the paper is {attachment_version}. The reply should go to: {recipients}.

assumptions.if_wrong: You would promise the wrong deadline to your professor.
An outdated draft would be sent.

assumptions.description: the reply goes to Professor Smith only
alternatives: Prof. Smith and both co-authors (reply all)
assumptions.if_wrong: Co-authors would not be informed (or would be included unexpectedly).

steps.label: Open thread
steps.description: Open the email thread 'Re: camera-ready deadline'

steps.label: Find latest draft
steps.description: Find the latest draft in Drive › Papers › CHI
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The wrong file could be picked as 'latest'.

steps.label: Draft reply
steps.description: Draft: 'Dear Prof. Smith, we will submit the revised draft by {deadline_day}…'
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The draft could state the wrong date.

preview.Draft: We will submit the revised draft by {deadline_day}. The current version is attached.

steps.label: Attach file
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The wrong file could be attached.

steps.label: Set recipients
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The recipient list could be wrong.

steps.label: Send email
steps.description: Send the reply to Professor Smith (simulated)
steps.consequence: External communication; the email leaves your account (simulated)
steps.what_could_go_wrong: A wrong recipient, date, or attachment reaches your professor and cannot be recalled.
alternatives: Save as draft for me to review

steps.label: File thread
steps.description: Move the thread to the 'Papers/CHI' folder
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The thread could be filed in the wrong folder.

steps.label: Create reminder
steps.description: Add a reminder 'Submit revised draft' on {deadline_day}
steps.what_could_go_wrong: The reminder could be set for the wrong day.

mistakes.description: Autocomplete replaced the address with j.smith@gmail.com, a different person.
The draft says 'we may not manage the deadline', the opposite of what you asked.

draft_reply.Draft: We may not manage to submit the revised draft by {deadline_day}.
